sprint.title: Sprint 189 — Browser design loop: see it, fix it, reconcile it
sprint.focus: Derek chose 2026-09-08 after the Sprint 188 review (planning PS-2026-09-08-012): Sprint 189 = the browser design loop plus the Sprint 188 carries. (a) Ship the reviewed Sprint 188 head (OODS-pro f4cd1ba3, public bytes d0cf5fe0) to the live PM2 bridge from the primary checkout and send the prepared reconnect to aquex-mcp and forge-demos. (b) Build the loop the program names in product-reality-program.md 'The intended loop': compose a screen from public inputs; render the same semantic state through the real React and Vue artifacts in a real browser with a machine-readable receipt (screenshots at 390/820/1440, layout measurements, accessibility-tree text, console errors, schema and artifact hashes); adjust the producer (composer, emitters, components), never a schema by hand; reconcile — the census enumerates every changed schema by class and the generated workflow app becomes the composition itself instead of a second set of controls beside it. (c) Use the loop to retire the ranked Sprint 188 craft carries (#1832): list and timeline contexts become real collections bound to the store (no second toolbar, no 'No items' above nine rows, no empty cards, no dead action buttons); form labels are names with descriptions as help text, recipe-owned fields suppress raw duplicates, datetime inputs show seeded values, one Save; detail is read-only with the cancel form on demand, no empty or duplicate tabs, AuditTimeline consistent with history, Archived shown as Yes/No; component fixes (ArchivedRowOverlay badge wrap, CancellationSummary 390px column, StatusTimeline React/Vue text parity, pluralization, sample-data realism); a public MCP tool design_preview over the same runnable, descopable. Test handling per #1833 lands before any capture (60 s budget or serial project for the git-range/census specs; dedupe root-core vs mcp-server double execution; one isolated rerun instead of a full recapture). Six serial missions: m01 ship; m02 loop render leg + test handling, receipts at the m01 head reproduce the review's defects mechanically; m03 list and timeline as collections; m04 form and detail reconcile; m05 component carries + sample data + design_preview; m06 census 66/66 + workflow, one four-suite capture under #1833, before/after receipt diff mapped to each #1832 item, advertised diff from f4cd1ba3, review handoff. Exit: every #1832 item resolved in a frozen-head receipt in both frameworks or explicitly carried with a reason; the independent review decides 'usable' with the receipts in hand. Pace rule: no per-mission captures, no new closeout apparatus, no critic. Build fresh from cmos/planning/forge-s189-browser-design-loop-decision-memo.md in ~/.codex/worktrees/s189/OODS-Forge (branch codex/sprint-189-browser-design-loop from f4cd1ba3); builder does not self-certify.
